events.summary: 一百条龙从海面下涌出，扑向凯萨瑟叛军的飞艇群，咬碎小船、以火焰熔化铁甲舰。
events.quote: A hundred dragons in all sizes and colors, emerging from beneath the waves, their massive wings carrying them to the tangle of airships within seconds.

events.summary: 弓帆船中弹下坠，阿拉里克张开影门护住两人，船撞地碎成数十片，他们却安然落在沙滩与岩石上。
events.quote: The Shadowgate blossomed around her. Around them both. A sphere of star-streaked midnight. The bowrider crashed into the ground hard enough that it fragmented into dozens of pieces

events.summary: 凯德驾绘有萨多维亚凤凰的小船从东面赶到，一轮铁弩把领头敌船打得偏离航线。
events.quote: A hail of iron bolts slammed into the lead ship, sending it spiraling wildly off-course. A new set of sails whirled in from the east, its red-and-orange stripes tarnished by pale moonlight.

events.summary: 有人从阴影里掷出陶壳炸弹，塔拉辛只来得及撑起最薄的护盾便被炸飞，撞在岩石上。
events.quote: Talasyn had only enough time to cast the flimsiest skeleton of a shield before the blast sent her flying.

events.summary: 伊莱丝、塞弗拉伊姆与妮塞妮身着暗铸军团铠甲现身，挡在塔拉辛身前面对逼近的士兵。
events.quote: Three figures clad in the armor of the Shadowforged Legion stepped into Talasyn’s field of vision, facing the oncoming soldiers

events.summary: 月食降临，塔拉辛穿过以太空间出现在跪着的阿拉里克身前，被利苏一剑刺入腹部。
events.quote: She appeared on her feet in front of Alaric’s kneeling form, facing Lisu. The commodore’s blade sank into her stomach.

events.summary: 塔拉辛用最后的气力拔出龙牙匕首，刺进利苏的颈静脉将他杀死。
events.quote: She tugged the dragon-fang dagger from its sheath and—with the last, fading vestiges of strength and motor function—she drove it straight into Lisu’s jugular.

events.summary: 塔拉辛在阿拉里克怀里说“因为我太厌倦不能先选择你”和“因为我爱你”，随后死去。
events.quote: “Because I was so tired of not getting to choose you first,” she murmured, her breath ghosting over his scarred cheek. “And because I love you.”

relations.relation: 夫妻，彼此深爱；他为她张开影门，她在月食中替他挡下利苏的剑
relations.quote: “Because I was so tired of not getting to choose you first,” she murmured, her breath ghosting over his scarred cheek. “And because I love you.”

relations.relation: 敌对；利苏刺穿她腹部，她反以龙牙匕首割断他的颈静脉
relations.quote: Lisu jerked back in shock but he was still holding on to the hilt, which ensured that he was still within Talasyn’s reach.

relations.relation: 盟友；凯德驾黄蜂小船赶到，替她挡住追击的狼群
relations.quote: She spun her wasp coracle around to face the oncoming wolves.

relations.b: 伊莱丝、塞弗拉伊姆、妮塞妮
relations.relation: 战友；三人以暗铸军团身份现身，用影门与飞刀杀退围攻她的士兵
relations.quote: “Really?” Nisene shouted at the soldiers. The Shadowgate roared forth from her and Ileis and Sevraim, their eyes flashing silver.

relations.relation: 龙出于本能保护涅纳瓦人，但不受任何人支配
relations.quote: Even though it was a dragon’s instinct to protect the Nenavarene, that didn’t give Talasyn—or anyone else—the right to make these creatures go to war.

numbers.context: 胡克特拉号驶向大陆的航程为三天
numbers.quote: She had seen, sparingly throughout the Huktera’s three-day voyage to the Continent, movement in the water.

numbers.context: 从海中升起的龙共一百条
numbers.quote: A hundred dragons in all sizes and colors, emerging from beneath the waves, their massive wings carrying them to the tangle of airships within seconds.
As Alaric helped her to her feet, the world washed over her in bits and pieces, images swimming together. The seven moons were out.

numbers.context: 利尔星的第六个月亮被阴影啃掉一角，即月食
numbers.quote: She thought, at first, that it was her blood blotting out a corner of Lir’s sixth moon from her sight, but after she had blinked away what she could, that shadow-bitten edge was still there.

numbers.context: 身着暗铸军团铠甲者共三人
numbers.quote: Three figures clad in the armor of the Shadowforged Legion stepped into Talasyn’s field of vision, facing the oncoming soldiers

numbers.context: 两人若不能相触，魔法需数分钟才能把他们拖进以太空间
numbers.quote: From previous experience, Talasyn knew that, if she and Alaric couldn’t touch, the magic would take several minutes to haul them both into aetherspace.
